actions.title: Open the glove box
actions.instruction: Open the glove box and prepare to release it from the dashboard.

actions.title: Disconnect the glove-box damper
actions.instruction: Disconnect the damper from the glove box as shown in the owner manual.

actions.title: Release and remove the glove box
actions.instruction: Push in the glove-box sides to release the stopper pins, then disengage the lower hinge points and remove the glove box.

actions.title: Release the filter retainers and remove the old filter
actions.instruction: Release the cabin-filter retainers and carefully pull the old filter from the housing so debris is not spilled into the HVAC case.

actions.title: Install the replacement filter with the arrow facing up
actions.instruction: Insert the replacement cabin air filter with its airflow/orientation arrow facing upward as specified by Subaru.

actions.title: Reinstall the glove box and damper
actions.instruction: Re-engage the glove-box hinge points, stopper pins, and damper in reverse order, then confirm the glove box opens and closes normally.
